instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: How is the unadjusted use case point total built?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُبنى مجموع نقاط حالات الاستخدام غير المعدّل؟
options: actor weight plus use case weight now
actor weight times use case weight
technical factor plus environmental factor
lines divided by person-months here
options_en: actor weight plus use case weight now
actor weight times use case weight
technical factor plus environmental factor
lines divided by person-months here
questions.explanation: The unadjusted total simply adds the actor weight to the use case weight.
questions.explanation_ar: المجموع غير المعدّل يجمع وزن الفاعلين مع وزن الحالات.

questions.question: What sets an actor's weight?
options: how many tests it runs now
how complex its interface is
how many methods it calls too
how old the actor is here
options_en: how many tests it runs now
how complex its interface is
how many methods it calls too
how old the actor is here
questions.explanation: A simple actor through an API weighs less than a complex graphical user.
questions.explanation_ar: الفاعل البسيط عبر واجهة برمجية وزنه أقل من مستخدم رسومي معقد.

questions.question: What sets a use case's weight?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي يحدد وزن حالة الاستخدام؟
options: the language used here too now again here
the hardware platform now here here
the number of transactions it contains
the number of developers again too
options_en: the language used here too now again here
the hardware platform now here here
the number of transactions it contains
the number of developers again too
questions.explanation: Use cases are classed simple, average or complex by how many transactions they carry.
questions.explanation_ar: الحالات تصنَّف بسيطة أو متوسطة أو معقدة حسب عدد معاملاتها.

questions.question: What does the technical complexity factor cover?
options: the salaries of the team here again again too here
the office layout here again too now here
the test schedule now too now here too now
distributedness, performance and similar needs
options_ar: تخطيط المكتب الآن هنا أيضاً الآن
جدول الاختبار أيضاً الآن هنا أيضاً
options_en: the salaries of the team here again again too here
the office layout here again too now here
the test schedule now too now here too now
distributedness, performance and similar needs
questions.explanation: The TCF rates the non-functional demands the system must satisfy.
questions.explanation_ar: العامل التقني يقيّم المتطلبات غير الوظيفية التي يجب أن يلبيها النظام.

questions.question: What does the environmental factor cover?
options: team skill and process maturity
the compiler version too now
the database size here here too
the network speed now again
options_en: team skill and process maturity
the compiler version too now
the database size here here too
the network speed now again
questions.explanation: The ECF captures how capable and how mature the team and its process are.
questions.explanation_ar: العامل البيئي يلتقط قدرة الفريق ونضج عمليته.

questions.question: How is effort estimated from use case points?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُقدَّر الجهد من نقاط حالات الاستخدام؟
options: square the point total here too here here
multiply the adjusted points by a rate
divide the points by the team size
add the points to the LOC now again
options_ar: بتربيع مجموع النقاط هنا أيضاً الآن
بقسمة النقاط على حجم الفريق هنا
بجمع النقاط مع الأسطر الآن مجدداً
options_en: square the point total here too here here
multiply the adjusted points by a rate
divide the points by the team size
add the points to the LOC now again
questions.explanation: Adjusted points are scaled by a productivity rate to reach person-hours.
questions.explanation_ar: النقاط المعدّلة تُضرب بمعدل إنتاجية للوصول إلى ساعات عمل.

questions.question: How do use case points differ from function points?
questions.question_ar: كيف تختلف نقاط حالات الاستخدام عن نقاط الوظائف؟
options: they need the finished code again
they count only the files now here
they are counted from use case models
they ignore the actors here too now here
options_en: they need the finished code again
they count only the files now here
they are counted from use case models
they ignore the actors here too now here
questions.explanation: UCP works from the use case model, while FP works from the data and transaction functions.
questions.explanation_ar: UCP يعمل من نموذج حالات الاستخدام، وFP من وظائف البيانات والمعاملات.

questions.question: When is UCP the better size measure?
questions.question_ar: متى تكون UCP مقياس الحجم الأفضل؟
options: after the code is finished
only during maintenance here here
only for hardware projects
early, before any code exists
options_en: after the code is finished
only during maintenance here here
only for hardware projects
early, before any code exists
questions.explanation: Use cases exist at requirements time, so UCP can size a project before design.
questions.explanation_ar: حالات الاستخدام موجودة وقت المتطلبات، فـUCP يقيس المشروع قبل التصميم.
